observation.command:
cd /workspace
for m in \
  "resources/js/pages/MainPage.vue" \
  "resources/js/components/Navigation.vue" \
  "resources/js/components/Sensor.vue" \
  "resources/js/components/Ochsi.vue" \
  "resources/js/components/HomeInfoCard.vue" \
  "resources/js/components/SensorCard.vue" \
  "resources/js/components/InfoCard.vue"; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/mod.out -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:5173/$m")
  echo "$code  $m"
  if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then head -5 /tmp/mod.out; fi
done
echo "=== check if UserInfo/UserMenuContent fetch 404/500 ==="
curl -s -o /tmp/u.out -w "UserInfo HTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:5173/resources/js/components/UserInfo.vue"
